description: Listen to Sadhu exposes a searchable corpus of Vedic scripture and recorded lectures. Look up verses by reference (e.g. "BG 2.13", "SB 5.5.3", "CC Madhya 8.128") with original Devanagari/Bengali, IAST transliteration and translations; read commentaries, prose chapters and letters; and search transcribed talks with semantic + lexical retrieval. Inline audio/video players let you hear a lecture passage or watch a clip. Read-only, no auth, no writes.

tool_signatures.name: document_list
tool_signatures.description: List documents at a reference / in a book. A verse's purport = document_list(source, tokens, kind:"commentary").

tokens.description: A specific reference; omit for the whole book.

tool_signatures.name: excerpt_prepare
tool_signatures.description: Generate (or fetch, if cached) the audio clip for a lecture passage and return its playable URL. This is the excerpt player's Play action — it is called for you by the player UI on demand. Agents should use lecture_excerpt to show the player, not call this directly. Idempotent: same track+window returns the same cached clip.

tool_signatures.name: lecture_excerpt
tool_signatures.description: Let the user HEAR a lecture passage inline. Call this when the user wants to LISTEN to a specific moment in a track — e.g. from a search(types:["track"]) hit, pass its track_id plus start_ms/end_ms. Renders an inline audio player that generates the clip on demand (public share-audio, max 10 minutes).

track_id.description: track_id (from a search track hit or track_list).

tool_signatures.name: media_get
tool_signatures.description: Show/play an existing corpus VIDEO clip inline. Call this when the user wants to WATCH a clip found via search(types:["media"]) — pass the hit's media_id. Renders an inline video player.

id.description: Media clip item_id (from a search media hit's media_id).

tool_signatures.name: search
tool_signatures.description: Semantic + lexical search over the corpus. Returns verses, documents, track passages and titles matching a natural-language query, each with the id needed to fetch the full record (verse_id→verse_get, document_id→document_get, track_id+start_ms/end_ms→transcript_window; media_id→media_get to play the clip). Every filter is optional. Use min_score to drop weak matches.

types.description: Subset of verse|document|track|title|media (default all). A `media` hit is a short video clip playable via media_get.

tokens.description: With source, restrict to a reference. A bare chapter number covers the WHOLE chapter ("7" = all of BG ch 7; "5.5" = SB canto 5 ch 5); add the verse for one verse ("7.1"). For tracks it means tracks citing that chapter/verse.

min_score.description: Drop hits scoring below this cosine floor (0..1, default 0 = no floor).

tool_signatures.name: source_get
tool_signatures.description: Get one book by id or code ("source_…" or "BG"/"БГ").

tool_signatures.name: source_list
tool_signatures.description: List all books (Caitanya-caritāmṛta is three sources).

tool_signatures.name: source_resolve
tool_signatures.description: Find a book by name (fuzzy): "gita", "бхагаватам", "CC Madhya".

tool_signatures.name: track_get
tool_signatures.description: Get a track (lecture/conversation): metadata, cited references, transcript/pdf availability.

tool_signatures.name: track_list
tool_signatures.description: List tracks, filterable by reference (source[+tokens] = tracks citing it), author/location/kind/date/lang. No filter ⇒ recent tracks (date desc).

lang.description: Has a transcript in this language.

source.description: Book code / source_id — tracks citing this book.

tokens.description: With source, filter to tracks citing this reference. A bare chapter number covers the WHOLE chapter ("7" = any BG 7.x lecture); add the verse for one verse ("7.1").

tool_signatures.name: transcript_window
tool_signatures.description: Read a track's transcript around a time window (from a search track hit or track_list). Widen with pad_ms.

tool_signatures.name: verse_get
tool_signatures.description: Get a verse: original (Devanagari/Bengali) + stored IAST transliteration + translation. Address by ref ("BG 2.13"), source+tokens, or verse id.

lang.description: If set: single translation; else a translations map.

tool_signatures.name: verse_list
tool_signatures.description: List the verses of a book / chapter. Skips .0 chapter summaries; collapses merged verses into one item with a covers span.
